description: Masks, mask and content effects and the Levels effect of the evaluator (04 sections 1 and 2, task phase1.11_compositor-mask-effects), evaluated by the CPU store under the current profile. Residuals are |delta| in export units (16-bit PNG codes, OpenEXR float32 values) per texture set and channel, against both recordings (r1 same session, r2 after save and reopen).

entries.subject: Mask stacks: background, a bitmap fill effect and its opacity, mask storage precision
entries.formula: m := background (White 1, Black 0); each visible mask effect bottom-up: a fill effect m := m + (r - m) alpha with r = kernel(mode, m, b) clamped to [0, 1], b the source's mono value and alpha the effect's opacity; m is stored at 16 bits (the UNORM write rule) after every effect on every channel format; the layer blends with opacity x m (a disabled or absent mask counts as 1).

parameters.name: write_rule
parameters.value: UNORM16, n + 4 fractional bits, ties down

entries.subject: The mix of a mask effect over the mask below it (two mask effects, Multiply)
entries.formula: v = a + (r - a) alpha for every mode (the layer mix a (1 - alpha) + r alpha misses 6 of 65536 texels of the second, Multiply, effect); the same mix is used for content fill effects.

entries.subject: Masks on a group (default mode and Normal) and on its Multiply child
entries.formula: A group's mask multiplies the opacity of its isolated composite exactly as a layer's mask does; a child's mask applies inside the group.

entries.notes: Evaluated under profile painter-12.1-isolated-coverage-weights (decision 058). Every map equals both recordings. The sRGB8 maps: the group coverage (255 + y)/510 lies half-way between two 8-bit codes on even rows, and Painter stores the code of its binary16 value (up on rows y mod 64 >= 32, down elsewhere; decision 044); the float32 value stored all ties down (3 709 values off). On the RGB32F row where the child's mask is 0 the uniform's float32 value reproduces the recordings (1 + (v - 1) leaves 8 values off). Where the child's mask is strictly between 0 and 1 the uniform Screen fill above it composites over a partly covered backdrop with the coverage weights of entry group-coverage-order (the W3C straight-colour order of the earlier profiles left 20 631 RGB32F and 57 RGB16 values one step off).

entries.subject: The float32 source-over onto a partly covered backdrop inside an isolated group
entries.formula: A layer composited onto a backdrop that is not opaque (coverage ab < 1, including a backdrop layer of coverage 0), with alpha as = opacity x mask x source alpha and blend result B = kernel(mode, Cb, Cs): wb = fl(ab fl(1 - as)), ao = fl(as + wb), ws = fl(ao - ab) (the weight of the source alone re-derived from the rounded coverage), C = fl(fma(ws, Cs, fma(ab, fl(as B), fl(wb Cb))) x Rcp(ao)) with the recording GPU's reciprocal; the coverage is ao. Over an opaque backdrop it reduces to the fitted opacity mix fl(fl(Cb (1 - as)) + fl(B as)); the first layer of an isolated list is copied over the empty start. The sRGB8 coverage plane goes through binary16 only from 1/2 up (decision 059); the RGB8 and L8 coverage planes take the plain 8-bit write rule, ties down.

entries.notes: Diagnostic golden of phase1.10_compositor-float32-residual (decision 048): over an opaque black root the export is g x ag, lossless where it lies in [1/2, 1). The order is identified on it and confirmed on group-masks s2-s3 and quantisation-thirds (quantisation-profile.json). Rows whose coverage sum 0.5 + 0.5 m is exact in float32 already matched the W3C straight-colour order; the others differ through ws = ao - ab. Opacity 0.3 over a mask of 0 gives fl(fl(Cs as) x Rcp(as)), not Cs, while the mask's own layer (the first of the group) is copied. Even rows of the 0.5 sets put the group coverage on an 8-bit tie: RGB8 and L8 store all of them down (the plain rule, no binary16). With opacity 0.3, eight coverages in [0.3, 0.5) lie on 8-bit ties: the sRGB8 plane stores all of them down while binary16 sends five up, so the binary16 step applies from 1/2 up only (its mechanism is not identified; the evidence below 1/2 is these eight rows).

entries.subject: The Levels effect of a content stack (one effect per channel)
entries.formula: t = (v - in_min) Rcp(in_max - in_min) with the recording GPU's reciprocal; when gamma is not 1, t = sign(t) pow(|t|, gamma) with pow(x, g) = exp2(g log2 x) through the recording GPU's log2 and exp2 (hwmath.h tables); out = fma(t, out_max - out_min, out_min); the result is stored in the channel format.

entries.subject: Levels at and beyond the range ends, with and without clamp
entries.formula: clamp limits the normalised input t to [0, 1] before gamma; the output range is not clamped (out of [0, 1] values reach the float channels; UNORM channels clamp at storage); chained levels effects store between effects.

entries.subject: A Black mask with a UV-projected 8-bit bitmap fill effect in Screen at 0.75 under a clamped levels effect with gamma 1.2 (API probe, BaseColor sRGB8)
entries.formula: The mask formulas above; the levels effect of a mask has no blending (the API refuses it) and remaps the mask in place. The BaseColor export is the sRGB encode of the stored code's sRGB8 decode (decision 126). Unstable golden: r1 (same session) is the exact target (decision 032); r2's residual is reported.

entries.notes: Equals r1 on all 196 608 values. Where the mask is 0 the layer stores the template base float32(0.8) as sRGB8 code 231, whose decode 0.80078125 exports 59422, not the 59397 of the empty channel's constant. r2 differs from r1 on 4 608 values by up to 252 codes (Painter is unstable on this probe after save and reopen, parity/reports/phase0/tier0-stability.md §4; not admitted), so the entry stays calibrated. The residuals published before came from this fit writing BaseColor's linear decode, the rule of the User channels, instead of its sRGB encode: 3048 while the template base held the export value 0.9063401 as a linear value (itself 3334 off with the encode), 6943 once decision 126 made the base linear. The evaluation of the mask stack did not change.

entries.subject: Content effects in list order (fill effect and levels)
entries.formula: Content effects run bottom-up in list order on the layer's own content for the channel, the content stored in the channel format after each effect: a fill effect blends its source for the channel with its per-channel mode and opacity through the effect mix, a levels effect remaps its affected channel only.

entries.notes: Release gap until P3-PROC: every Tier 0 order but s6 (levels alone, entry `levels`) and s7 (Blur alone) holds the starter-asset Blur filter, so the order of fill and levels effects and the content fill effect's mix are implemented from the documented list order and the fitted mask-effect mix but not observed. s0-s5 and s7 are owned by phase3.2_proc-filter-families item 3.4 (decision 069).

entries.subject: Geometry masks of type Mesh (inclusion or exclusion list of mesh objects)
entries.formula: The mask is multiplied by the texel-centre coverage (UV raster convention) of the texture set's triangles of the included objects; UVTile geometry masks fail explicitly.
